description.message: Translate text in the browser with PLaMo 3 Translate running locally in PLaMo Translate Desktop.

sourcePlaceholder.message: Text to translate. Select text on a page and choose "Translate with PLaMo" from the context menu, or type or paste it here (Ctrl+Enter translates).

doneCut.message: Done · $COUNT$ passage(s) kept repeating and were cut

noticeSetup.message: Cannot reach PLaMo Translate Desktop. Open the app, go to Settings (the gear in the status bar), and choose "Connect" under Browser extension. Then reload this panel.

noticeDisconnected.message: The connection to PLaMo Translate Desktop ended: $ERROR$

errorNoModel.message: No model is selected. Choose and download one in PLaMo Translate Desktop (the model button in the status bar).

errorModelMissing.message: The selected model file is missing. Choose a model again in PLaMo Translate Desktop.

settingsHint.message: Downloaded models are listed; download others in PLaMo Translate Desktop. Changing these does not change the app's own selection.

releaseTitle.message: End the connection to PLaMo Translate Desktop and free the model's memory. The next translation loads it again.

statusReleased.message: Released · loads again on the next translation
